title: Payments Desk Schedule: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Prepayment Limits, Methods and Window
content:
Each Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan sets the largest prepayment it accepts for one plan, the ways the prepayment can be paid, the number of calendar days after purchase within which the prepayment must be received, and whether a business account may pay it on invoice.

| Plan | Largest prepayment accepted for one plan | Accepted ways to pay | Payment window (calendar days after purchase) | Business account may pay on invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | $3000.00 | Credit card, debit card, ACH bank account | 3 | No |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | $5000.00 | Credit card, debit card, ACH bank account | 3 | No |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | $6000.00 | Credit card, debit card, ACH bank account | 3 | Yes |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | $8000.00 | Credit card, debit card, ACH bank account | 3 | Yes |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | $10000.00 | ACH bank account, credit card | 5 | Yes |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | $12000.00 | ACH bank account, credit card | 5 | Yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- **Debit cards.** The 18- and 24-month plans accept an ACH bank account or a credit card; a debit card is not on their list. The four shorter plans accept all three.
- **Invoice payment.** Invoice is not among the accepted ways to pay listed above. A business account may pay the prepayment on invoice under the 9-, 12-, 18- and 24-month plans; under the 3- and 6-month plans that invoice option is not available.
- **The per-plan limit, both sides (hypothetical amounts).** A 6-month plan prepayment of exactly $5000.00 is within that plan's limit; $5000.01 exceeds it. A 3-month plan prepayment of $3000.00 is within its limit; $3000.01 is not.
- **The window.** The payment window is three calendar days for the 3- through 12-month plans and five calendar days for the 18- and 24-month plans.
